_meta.status: PARTIAL — 18 of 49 trails resolved. Do not treat the other 31 as researched.
_meta.blocker: The WebSearch budget for this session was already exhausted (200/200 used) before this task issued its first query. Every search returned 'web search was not performed'. All data below therefore comes from authority pages fetched directly with WebFetch and read in full.
_meta.why_no_alltrails_field: AllTrails could not be checked for ANY trail. alltrails.com answers 403 to automated fetching (LINKS_STRATEGY.md §2), so the only route to an AllTrails URL, rating or elevation gain is a web search snippet — and search was unavailable. Absence of an `alltrails` key below means NOT CHECKED. It does NOT mean no listing exists, and none of these should be recorded as match:'none'/tier:'unlisted' — that is a positive claim of absence this session could not test.
_meta.missing_fields: elevation_gain and reviews are absent throughout. Land managers publish neither; both are AllTrails metrics. Per §1 they are left out rather than estimated.
_meta.to_finish: Re-run with CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_WEB_SEARCHES_PER_SESSION raised. The 31 unresolved trails are listed in _unresolved.

trails.name: Elora Quarry Conservation Area Trail

other_links.label: Grand River Conservation Authority — Elora Quarry
other_links.note: Managing authority confirms the trail exists: a one-kilometre loop through cedar forest, in places overlooking the Grand River. GRCA gives it no formal proper name and publishes no difficulty grade.

other_links.note: Managing authority. A park pass is required for all trails.

other_links.label: NPS — Sleeping Bear Dunes trails
other_links.note: Managing authority. Distance is a range because of the loop/spur options.

trails.name: Dune Climb / Cottonwood Trail loop

other_links.label: NPS — Sleeping Bear Dunes trails
other_links.note: Managing authority. Lists Cottonwood Trail at 1.5 mi, Moderate.

trails.stats_note: Our card name pairs two things NPS treats differently. NPS lists no 'Dune Climb' as a standalone trail — it is a trailhead, and the trail leaving it is the Dunes Hiking Trail (3.5 mi, Strenuous), which is NOT the Cottonwood Trail. The 1.5 mi / Moderate figures are the Cottonwood Trail alone. Worth splitting this into two entries, or renaming to 'Cottonwood Trail'.

other_links.label: Wisconsin DNR — Peninsula State Park hiking
other_links.note: Managing authority. A 0.6-mile portion is graveled for universal access — the flattest option on this stop.

other_links.label: Wisconsin DNR — Peninsula State Park hiking
other_links.note: Managing authority. Runs below 150-foot cliffs past springs and forested terraces. 'More difficult' is the DNR's own three-step scale (Easiest / Moderate / More difficult), not an AllTrails grade.

trails.name: 3 Dune Challenge, Indiana Dunes State Park

other_links.label: Indiana DNR — Indiana Dunes State Park
other_links.note: Managing authority. The route is the park's Trail 8, 1.5 miles, graded RUGGED, which 'covers the three highest dunes'. DNR lists the 3 Dune Hiking Challenge as an activity but publishes no separate spec for it.

trails.stats_note: Figures are Indiana DNR's for Trail 8, the trail the challenge follows. 'Rugged' is the DNR's own top grade (Easy / Moderate / Rugged).
